notes.title: RIFT Beta Patch 2
notes.content: [p]The [i]publicbetatesting[/i] branch has received a new build with bug fixes and QoL updates![/p][p]You can access this branch by right-clicking [i]Rift of the NecroDancer[/i] in your Steam library ➡️ Properties ➡️ Betas, and opting into [i]publicbetatesting[/i] from the dropdown. Build 1.7.1-b21290 is live on the `[i]publicbetatesting[/i]` beta branch on Steam - visit the "Properties" menu for Rift in your Steam library and navigate to the "Betas" tab to opt into this beta branch![/p][p][/p][h2]🔁 Changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]Changed[/b] practice mode to allow taking damage[/p][list][*][p]Now, missing a hit in practice mode will actually decrease HP[/p][/*][*][p]If HP is decreased past 0, it will go into the negatives (so you can see how many times you were hit)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Added[/b] early and late indicators to MISSed notes[/p][list][*][p]E and L indicators will display on MISSes (requires the E/L indicator setting to be turned on)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Changed[/b] vibe chains to still be rewarded even if food in the vibe chain was missed[/p][list][*][p]Previously, missing a food item that was part of a vibe chain would not reward vibe power correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Now, food can be missed and the chain will still correctly give vibe power[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Changed[/b] track select menu scroll speed[/p][list][*][p]Just an experiment! We'd love to hear how you feel about it[/p][/*][*][p]We DIDN'T change Custom Music scroll speed, so you can easily compare there[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2][b]⚒️ [/b]Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed traps not appearing if the practice mode range was set to just after they were meant to appear[/p][list][*][p]This also resolves the fan favourite issue of Twombtorial Challenge being inaccurate from the actual level![/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed Electric Avenue being rewarded when using Golden Lute modifier[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sorting by BPM not working correctly after changing difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the navigation bar UI not updated to new keybinds immediately[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed immediate reentry of some menus not working correctly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the story mode menu position resetting when quitting the hard boss battle tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the story mode menu position resetting when quitting from the game over screen of a boss battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed high score banner failing to appear if a higher score was achieved offline[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed positive VO playing when getting a game over in Challenges[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a beatmap error in the final boss battle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a softlock that occurred when entering and exiting the calibration test from inside the bestiary[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed vibe power not scaling with playback speed in practice mode[/p][list][*][p]Vibe power now correctly lasts longer when playing at 50% speed, for more accurate placement practice[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed feedback form overlapping dialogue in story mode gameplay[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed controls menu position resetting when changing a key bind[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed minigames not always displaying the early and late indicators[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed changing practice mode parameters and then disabling and re-enabling practice mode not returning the parameters to default[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed (? hopefully) the final hit VFX not playing[/p][list][*][p]There were about 7 unique and exciting ways this could occur, but we hopefully got all of them! Please report if you see this issue again[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed (partially) a softlock that could occur during the first boss battle transition if the game was paused at the wrong time[/p][list][*][p]This is a bandaid fix for a deeper issue that is much riskier to resolve without impacting the rest of the game[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed several remix mode inaccuracies (mostly in the editor)[/p][/*][/list]

tags.feature: [b]Added[/b] early and late indicators to MISSed notes

Fixed Electric Avenue being rewarded when using Golden Lute modifier

Fixed immediate reentry of some menus not working correctly
Fixed the story mode menu position resetting when quitting the hard boss battle tutorial
Fixed the story mode menu position resetting when quitting from the game over screen of a boss battle
Fixed high score banner failing to appear if a higher score was achieved offline
Fixed positive VO playing when getting a game over in Challenges

notes.title: RIFT Beta Patch 1
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone. If you want to help us test [i]Rift of the NecroDancer[/i] updates early, we've set up a public beta branch on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p]You can access this branch by right-clicking [i]Rift of the NecroDancer[/i] in your Steam library ➡️ Properties ➡️ Betas, and opting into [i]publicbetatesting[/i] from the dropdown. We plan to update this branch semi-regularly with ad hoc updates. While you can get access to builds early, please note that you may encounter more bugs than usual in these builds.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854401/43dfeb20016050556b01d0ec500ac0148d28c022.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Build 1.5.1-b20897 is live on the `[i]publicbetatesting[/i]` beta branch on Steam - visit the "Properties" menu for Rift in your Steam library and navigate to the "Betas" tab to opt into this beta branch![/p][p][/p][h2][b]⚒️ Fixes[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed exiting and reentering the controls menu not resetting the menu selection to the top[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Vibe Chain SFX not being attached to any SFX sliders[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed later boss portraits being visible when a chapter was completed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed 'Play Back to Back' option causing incorrect boss tutorials to play if difficulty was changed in a previous level[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed new calibration values being saved even when the new values were not confirmed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed full combo being awarded if the level was failed before monsters appeared when Coda Modifier was equipped[/p][list][*][p]This also fixes the achievements [i]All a-Coda to Plan[/i] and [i]Impossible, right?[/i] being awarded incorrectly[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed inputs not being registered briefly if they were held when the game changed input contexts (ie, going from gameplay to a tutorial and back)[/p][/*][/list]

tags.bug: Fixed exiting and reentering the controls menu not resetting the menu selection to the top
Fixed Vibe Chain SFX not being attached to any SFX sliders
Fixed later boss portraits being visible when a chapter was completed
Fixed 'Play Back to Back' option causing incorrect boss tutorials to play if difficulty was changed in a previous level
Fixed new calibration values being saved even when the new values were not confirmed
Fixed full combo being awarded if the level was failed before monsters appeared when Coda Modifier was equipped
This also fixes the achievements [i]All a-Coda to Plan[/i] and [i]Impossible, right?[/i] being awarded incorrectly
Fixed inputs not being registered briefly if they were held when the game changed input contexts (ie, going from gameplay to a tutorial and back)

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Patch 1.4.0-b20609[/h3]

[h2]⚒️ Fixes [/h2]

[*] New High Score banner sometimes doesn't display correctly (both in Remix and in Custom Music)

[/list]

notes.title: RIFT Hotfix #3
notes.content:
[h2]📢 Important Information 📢[/h2]

If you have at any point installed a mod to Rift of the NecroDancer, you may find that the game no longer launches correctly or experiences strange bugs during gameplay. Before launching this newest update, please make sure that you have uninstalled any mod launchers (ie BepInEx, MelonLoader)! You will also need to find and delete the file [i]winhttp.dll[/i] within the game install folder if it exists.

[h3]⚒️ Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed credits missing a couple names for the community level designer section
[/list]

notes.title: Happy 10 Years of NecroDancing!
notes.content:
Ten years ago, we unleashed a game so groovy, it woke the dead (literally!). Crypt of the NecroDancer has been keeping your fingers tapping and your hearts pounding for a whole decade! That's right, we've officially hit double digits – time for a mid-life crisis where we buy a fancy new lute and maybe get a dancing dragon tattoo?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854401/9f31e2eb9281674b264d75c221cec52ff0af51eb.jpg[/img]
But instead of existential d(r)ead, we're bringing you gifts! In the spirit of cross-game pollination (and because we thought it would be super cool), we're sneaking THREE legendary tracks from Crypt of the NecroDancer into Rift:
[list][*] Crypteque
[*] Fungal Funk
[*] Power Cords[/list]
And because looking good is half the battle (especially when facing down a horde of skeletons), these songs feature new Crypt outfits for Cadence and the NecroDancer. Now you can bring that classic Crypt style to your Rift runs.

Thanks for sticking with us through all the beats and bobs. Here's to another ten years of rhythmic mayhem!

That's not all! If you haven't yet, you can pick up the Crypt of the NecroDancer Ultimate Pack for an ALL-TIME LOW of 55% off for a limited time only.

[h2]🥳 [strike]-5%[/strike] 55%[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2553/NecroDancer_ULTIMATE_PACK/

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[h3]Patch 1.3.0-b20453[/h3]
[quote]If you see a 🎸 emoji, know that you as a community helped us make this change, whether that was by providing feedback or reporting bugs![/quote]
[h2]🆕 New Content and Features[/h2]
[list][*] [b]Added[/b] three new Rhythm Rifts based on tracks from [i]Crypt of the NecroDancer[/i]:
[list]
    [*] [i]Zone 1-2[/i]: Crypteque
    [*] [i]Zone 2-1[/i]: Fungal Funk
    [*] [i]Zone 5-2[/i]: Power Cords
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] classic Crypt-style outfits worn by Cadence and the NecroDancer while playing the Crypt tracks
[*] 🎸 [b]Added[/b] custom portrait support to Custom Music tracks
[list]
    [*] This includes official compatibility with existing tracks designed for 96 LB's [i]CustomPortRifts[/i] mod!
[/list]
[*] [b]Added[/b] Shopkeeper Mode support to Custom Music tracks
[list]
    [*] See here for more info on custom portraits and Shopkeeper Mode: https://vortexbuffer.com/rift/editor-advanced/[/list][/list]
[h2]🔁 Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] unlock criteria for DLC tracks:
[list]
    [*] From now on, the Impossible difficulty and Remix Mode will be unlocked by default for any song that requires purchase
    [*] Free tracks added via content updates follow the same set of unlock criteria as base game tracks for Impossible difficulty (100 diamonds), Remix Mode (60 diamonds) and Impossible Remix Mode (120 diamonds)
[/list]
[*] [b]Changed[/b] asset storage format to reduce download size for future updates
[list]
    [*] Future updates to the game should require much less data to be downloaded![/list][/list]
[h2]🔧 Level Editor Changes (v4.1.1-b5470)[/h2]
[list][*] 🎸 [b]Added[/b] support for offsetting the audio track by a specific number of milliseconds to sync it up with the beatmap
[list]
    [*] This offset is visually indicated by the waveform display on the side of the track, and also applies to preview playback[/list]
[*] 🎸 [b]Added[/b] an option to play a 4-beat or 8-beat countdown at the start of a song
[list]
    [*] The countdown's BPM is based on the starting BPM of the song, independent of BPM change triggers
    [*] The countdown audio does not play in the editor, and is instead represented by visual annotations on the right side of the level
    [*] This can be configured on a per-difficulty basis
    [*] For compatibility, existing songs continue to use silent countdowns by default[/list]
[*] 🎸 [b]Added[/b] an option to select which existing Workshop item to replace when publishing a track
[*] [b]Added[/b] a hotkey to mirror the contents of the paintbrush or selection rectangle
[list]
    [*] This is bound to [i]H[/i] by default, but can be configured via the options menu[/list]
[*] 🎸 [b]Added[/b] a "Halve BPM" tool, which transforms all enemies on the song into their equivalent half-BPM counterparts, preserving the timings of each hit at a reduced scroll speed
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] enemies sometimes being saved at beat times below the start of the song[/list]
[h2]⚒️ Bugfixes[/h2]
[list][*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] "DLC now available" item not being removed from Track Select after obtaining all DLCs
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] Skulls sometimes spawning Skeletons 2 tiles back instead of 1 tile back
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] enemy hit sounds being out of sync near mid-song BPM changes
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] enemy timing accuracy issues in [i]Resurrections[/i] Hard and Impossible
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] Skeleton timing accuracy issues in [i]Scattered and Lost[/i] Hard
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] Armadillos snapping to the incorrect sub-beat intervals on [i]Visualize Yourself[/i] Impossible
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] pause menu not opening when pressing the pause button near the end of the song
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] Practice Mode start/end range not being applied accurately to songs with variable BPM
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] leaderboards not always being hidden when the Golden Lute modifier is equipped
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] the background video in Rhythm Rifts continuing to play while the game is paused
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] unpause countdown not staying in sync with the rhythm on songs with variable BPM
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] seeded leaderboard toggle not working on the Remix Mode results screen
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Shopkeeper talking over his own singing in Shopkeeper Mode
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] slow loading times for Track Select and Custom Music menus
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] inconsistent audio synchronization when beginning playback for some Custom Music tracks
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] fractional BPM values being rounded to integers in Custom Music
[*] 🎸 [b]Fixed[/b] unpublished Custom Music tracks sending records to the leaderboards
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Custom Music tracks not contributing towards the play time statistics on Steam Workshop
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Custom Music menu sometimes showing outdated scores in the small leaderboard view
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] the pause menu's difficulty selector not working in Custom Music
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] changes to the Practice Mode start/end range from the pause menu not applying in Custom Music
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] game over screen not allowing the difficulty to be changed in Custom Music
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] infinite loading screen when starting a Custom Music track without any enemies
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] missing sound effect when entering a Custom Music track
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Cyan, Magenta and Yellow Portal Traps all appearing as blue in-game
[*] [b]Fixed[/b] Celeste and Super Meat Boy tracks not always appearing in the same order in Track Select when sorting by character[/list]
[h2]🪲 Known issues[/h2]
[quote]We're moving to action on these as quickly as possible, but some of these issues have fixes that require more delicate handling. Thanks for your patience![/quote]
[list][*] Exiting a boss battle tutorial will return the player to the top of the Story Mode menu
[*] After completing a boss battle it's possible to see all boss portraits in the menu when scrolling up and down the list
[*] The kerning on text in artist names is broken if the name contains 'GI'
[*] Boss battles sometimes do not load the correct difficulty if Play Back-to-Back is enabled
[*] An animation bug occurs in [i]Show Time![/i] Hard difficulty that makes the game more difficult to play than intended
[*] NVIDIA graphics cards may cause framerate issues
[list]
    [*] [b]Workaround[/b]: Edit the [i][noparse]SaveData[/noparse][/i] file in a text editor (located in [i][noparse]%userprofile%\AppData\LocalLow\Brace Yourself Games\Rift of the NecroDancer\Saves[/noparse][/i]) and change the [i][noparse]FramerateLimit[/noparse][/i] value to match your monitor's refresh rate (e.g. 60, 144, etc.)
[/list]
[*] Japanese and Chinese fonts do not display punctuation correctly
[*] New High Score banner sometimes doesn't display correctly (both in Remix and in Custom Music)
[*] Assist indicators for the minigames can disappear occasionally[/list]

[h1]🪲 Known Issues[/h1]
[quote]We're moving to action on these as quickly as possible, but some of these issues have fixes that require more delicate handling. Thanks for your patience![/quote]

[*] Inputs are not registered for a brief period after closing a tutorial dialogue box
[*] Audio calibration blips are sometimes off by a few milliseconds, which can result in inaccurate calibration results

notes.title: RIFT Hotfix #1
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Hope you've had a blast crushing those monsters and taking photos of Heph.

We have been absolutely blown away by the response to [i]Rift of the NecroDancer[/i] since it came out yesterday. We appreciate all the feedback we've received so far. Please keep sending stuff our way -- we read everything that comes in!

There are a few small-but-annoying bugs that we wanted to get a hotfix out for ASAP, so read below for the full list of changes and known issues.

[h2]🔁 Changes [/h2]
[list]
[*] Added the words 'Custom Music' to the gameplay screen when playing a custom track to help distinguish between official and custom music
[/list]
[h2]⚒️ Fixes [/h2]
[list]
[*] Disabled the automatic FPS throttling when the game is unfocused
[*] This also fixes the softlock that could occur when unfocusing the game while the feedback form was open
[*] Reduced the resolution of all videos to prevent stuttering on low end PCs
[*] Prevented a softlock that would occur when entering the Calibration Test from a custom track
[*] Fixed a performance dip that occurred when triggering vibe power while 'Remove Guitar Strings' was set to Enabled
[/list]
[h2]🪲 Known issues [/h2]
We're moving to action on these as quickly as possible, but due to the more complicated fixes we need a little bit more testing time. Thanks for your patience!

[list]
[*] It's possible to soft-lock boss battles when hitting extremely late in the input window right before a phase transition
[*] Boss battles sometimes do not load the correct difficulty if Play Back-to-Back is enabled
[*] Triggers and joysticks cause double inputs on all controllers (with the exception of SteamDeck)
[*] Workaround: Enable Steam Input in the Steam library properties for Rift of the NecroDancer
[*] Double inputs occur when playing using DualSense controllers (PS4 and PS5)
[*] Workaround: Enable Steam Input in the Steam library properties for Rift of the NecroDancer
[*] An animation bug occurs in Show Time! Hard difficulty that makes the game more difficult to play than intended
[*] The results screen for all boss battle Rhythm Rifts displays the incorrect song name
[*] On Repeat achievement triggers incorrectly
[*] A hidden achievement related to story completion triggers incorrectly
[*] Shielded Skeletons sometimes behave incorrectly
[*] NVIDIA graphics card settings may cause framerate issues
[*] Workaround: Edit the SaveData file (via C:\Users\your username\AppData\LocalLow\Brace Yourself Games\Rift of the NecroDancer) and set the FramerateLimit value to match your monitor's refresh rate (e.g. 60, 144, etc.)
[*] Japanese and Chinese fonts do not display punctuation correctly
[*] The tutorial does not pick up on the Invert Up/Down setting correctly
[*] New High Score banner sometimes doesn't display correctly
[*] Banshee does not enter the correct animation when stunned occasionally
[*] Turkish PCs will not display text correctly
[/list]
Known Issues for the Level Editor will come at a later date!

notes.title: The Rift Opens February 5, 2025
notes.content:
Hey there, NecroDancers! We’ve got some news about the state of the game, as well as a bit of a tempo change.

[h2]Rift of the NecroDancer is [i]almost[/i] done[/h2]

Rift of the NecroDancer is coming along nicely. As of now, the game is pretty much content complete, and we're having a blast playing it. It’s been awesome to see everyone’s reactions to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029150/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer_Demo/]our demo[/url] too!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029150/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer_Demo/

[h2]BUT... (you knew there was a "but," didn't you?)[/h2]

To hit a 2024 launch date, we would have needed to do some serious crunch to polish and bug-fix. Here at Brace Yourself Games, we're all about a sustainable groove, not the grind. We believe in making awesome games without sacrificing our team's well-being.

We decided to avoid cutting certain features to hit a 2024 launch date and possibly being forced into releasing something half-baked. So, we're taking a deep breath, stepping back, and giving Rift of the NecroDancer just a LITTLE bit more time in the oven.

One of the things we’re doing to give ourselves a little more time is decoupling Steam launch from additional platforms. This means that we’ll launch on Steam first, and follow on console at a later date. That date is still TBD, but we’re ready to share the Steam launch date, so keep reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854401/ca8f7b9790a20ff9883db3bed8f8ed89a14001f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]What’s taking so long?[/h2]

You might be saying, “Brace Yourself Games, you already announced a delay last year. What’s going on? I want to play this game already!!!”

To that, I say SAME. But let me give you a little insight into what we’ve been doing this last year, and why we need just a couple more months.

[olist][*] [b]IMPOSSIBLE Difficulty. [/b]The game was originally going to just have EASY, MEDIUM, and HARD, but we decided to add a fourth difficulty level: IMPOSSIBLE (previously known as EXPERT). IMPOSSIBLE is uh… really hard. We want a little extra time to tune this so it’s not actually impossible, right? But it’s still going to be really hard.
[*] [b]More Rhythm Rifts.[/b] We added even MORE Rhythm Rift beatmaps to songs like the boss battle tracks.
[*] [b]Off-beat Readability.[/b] The readability of off-beat monsters is probably our number one most received piece of feedback. We’ve been doing a lot of experimenting and playtesting to get this to a state we’re happy with.
[*] [b]Custom Music Tools. [/b]Thanks to the help of the dev behind Crypt of the NecroDancer: SYNCHRONY DLC, we did a full revamp of Rift’s internal level editing tool. Not only that, but we’re preparing it to be released publicly at launch so you can all use this tool to create custom charts to custom songs.
[*] [b]Remix Mode and Daily Challenges. [/b]Remix Mode started off as one of those “wouldn’t it be cool if…” ideas that ended up actually being REALLY COOL. The TL;DR of Remix Mode is that it throws a fresh chart your way every playthrough while retaining the original level's rhythmic design. That makes Daily Challenges possible, by changing up the circumstances for each song. And we love Daily Challenges. We’d love to do a more in-depth blog about Remix Mode soon to talk about the nuances of developing Remix Mode!
[*] [b]Tutorial and Practice Mode Improvements.[/b] We’ve made a lot of improvements to our tutorials and practice mode based on feedback we received from the demo. The tutorials are more comprehensive, and we also added in a highly request slowdown functionality (up to 50%) into practice mode to help you better parse difficult patterns in high BPM songs.
[*] [b]Animation Clarity and Feel.[/b] We’ve gone through a bunch of iterations on character/monster animations throughout development. If you take a look at [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cV528_7Nx-E]our very first trailer[/url] and compare it to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029150/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer_Demo/]the demo[/url], you’ll see what a massive difference it is!
[*] [b]Background Visualizers. [/b]Technically no one asked for this, but this is something that we really wanted to do, and we discovered it adds a lot more visual variety to each Rhythm Rift, which helps us and content creators make better videos.
[*] [b]Boss Battle and Story Revamp.[/b] We felt there was room for improvement with the state of boss battles and story mode, so we decided to give these aspects a total facelift.
[*] Shine Factor. We’ve addressed the majority of our high-impact bugs, but we want to make sure this game is polished to a mirror sheen![/olist]
With all that said…

[h2]Rift of the NecroDancer is launching February 5th, 2025.[/h2]

We're so confident in this new date that we're announcing it right now. No more "coming soon" or vague windows. Mark your calendars, folks, because the NecroDancer is opening the Rift on [b]February 5th, 2025.[/b]

There you have it. We know it's a bit of a wait, and we are so grateful to have a community like you that trusts in us enough to let us cook for as long as we need. In the meantime, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029150/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer_Demo/]our Steam demo[/url] is still up, so if you haven’t checked that out, you should definitely give it a shot. We'll also keep you updated with behind-the-scenes peeks, and dev content. If you have any questions or just want to hang out with us while we finish this game, you should [url=http://discord.gg/braceyourselfgames]join our Discord[/url]. It would also be a great help to our team if you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073250/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer/]add Rift of the NecroDancer to your wishlist[/url]. 😊

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854401/b7cf0f780cab5bbaf6d0a7cbfdd3eece4ac117b0.png[/img]

Thanks for your understanding, your patience, and your endless enthusiasm for all things NecroDancer. We can't wait to share this game with you.

The Brace Yourself Games Team

IMPOSSIBLE is uh… really hard. We want a little extra time to tune this so it’s not actually impossible, right? But it’s still going to be really hard.
More Rhythm Rifts. We added even MORE Rhythm Rift beatmaps to songs like the boss battle tracks.

Off-beat Readability. The readability of off-beat monsters is probably our number one most received piece of feedback. We’ve been doing a lot of experimenting and playtesting to get this to a state we’re happy with.

Custom Music Tools. Thanks to the help of the dev behind Crypt of the NecroDancer: SYNCHRONY DLC, we did a full revamp of Rift’s internal level editing tool. Not only that, but we’re preparing it to be released publicly at launch so you can all use this tool to create custom charts to custom songs.

Remix Mode and Daily Challenges. Remix Mode started off as one of those “wouldn’t it be cool if…” ideas that ended up actually being REALLY COOL. The TL;DR of Remix Mode is that it throws a fresh chart your way every playthrough while retaining the original level's rhythmic design. That makes Daily Challenges possible, by changing up the circumstances for each song. And we love Daily Challenges. We’d love to do a more in-depth blog about Remix Mode soon to talk about the nuances of developing Remix Mode!

Tutorial and Practice Mode Improvements. We’ve made a lot of improvements to our tutorials and practice mode based on feedback we received from the demo. The tutorials are more comprehensive, and we also added in a highly request slowdown functionality (up to 50%) into practice mode to help you better parse difficult patterns in high BPM songs.

Animation Clarity and Feel. We’ve gone through a bunch of iterations on character/monster animations throughout development. If you take a look at [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cV528_7Nx-E]our very first trailer[/url] and compare it to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3029150/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer_Demo/]the demo[/url], you’ll see what a massive difference it is!

Background Visualizers. Technically no one asked for this, but this is something that we really wanted to do, and we discovered it adds a lot more visual variety to each Rhythm Rift, which helps us and content creators make better videos.
Boss Battle and Story Revamp. We felt there was room for improvement with the state of boss battles and story mode, so we decided to give these aspects a total facelift.

tags.bug: Shine Factor. We’ve addressed the majority of our high-impact bugs, but we want to make sure this game is polished to a mirror sheen!

notes.title: Rift of the NecroDancer welcomes Klei as its new publisher for a 2024 release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42854401/e3a701d589d0e54645a68d23b076b8c536821438.jpg[/img]

Hey folks! We have 2 pieces of big news to share about Rift of the NecroDancer today:

[olist]
[*] Rift is now being published by our good friends at Klei
[*] Rift of the Necrodancer is now targeting a 2024 release
[/olist]
Below are some answers to a couple questions!

[h3][b]Q: Why 2024?[/b][/h3]
[b]A:[/b] The game is actually in really good shape right now, but we realized that we want to take some extra time to make it really SING.

We’ll also be able to double down on what makes the game great by adding more Rhythm Rifts for launch!

[h3][b]Q: Why Klei?[/b][/h3]
[b]A: [/b]Klei originally published Crypt of the NecroDancer, and we trust them with our lives. For real. Like 10/10 ❤️ Their support is giving us that extra time we need to get Rift to the finish line.


[h3][b]Q: So when is your new release date?[/b][/h3]
[b]A: [/b]We don’t have an exact date yet, but we’re looking at the first half of 2024. We’re hoping to have a release date for y’all after the holidays. 🙂


We know you’re highly anticipating this game. We’ll be sharing more Rift content leading up to launch, including more news about the INSANELY talented musicians involved! You can also expect a free demo in a future Steam Next Fest, and a new demo at PAX West 2023.

All in all, thank you for all your support and your continued hype for Rift of the NecroDancer, and another big thank you to Klei for allowing us to take the time we need to make this game a real stunner. We appreciate you all endlessly.

Don't forget to wishlist and/or follow Rift of the NecroDancer if you haven't already to keep up with the latest updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2073250/Rift_of_the_NecroDancer/

You can also join us in our [url=https://discord.gg/braceyourselfgames]Discord[/url] or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/NecroDancerGame]Twitter[/url]!
